name: Demucs v4 (htdemucs) - faster
summary: Hybrid Transformer Demucs, one model. Four stems: vocals, drums, bass, other.
quality: Upstream README reports 9.00 dB SDR on MUSDB18-HQ for htdemucs.
speed: One model pass per chunk: about four times faster than htdemucs_ft.

install.note: Downloads the checkpoint, converts it on this machine with the committed skeleton, deletes the download. Runs only in builds that include ONNX Runtime (stems_available()).
